items.title: Bill Allred interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017
items.q: A great fan of Abe Lincoln. That was my boy you know... I was madly in love with Abe Lincoln... Abe Lincoln was his trombone player.

ctx.x: But anyway Dean Kincaid said to me, he said, “Man, I like the way you play.” And I was 32 years old and hot to trot, you know, doing it all. A great fan of Abe Lincoln. That was my boy you know. The west coast, Abram Lincoln.
I’m not familiar with him I’m sorry to say.
